STATES.OFF: The ERP integration is off. Talk to the account administrator.
STATES.OFF_ADMIN: The ERP integration is off. Open ERP settings, fill in the companies and turn it on.

ERRORS.LOADING: The ERP is slow to answer. Try again in a few seconds.
ERRORS.UNAVAILABLE: The ERP did not answer. Try again shortly.
ERRORS.WRITE_DISABLED: Writing to the ERP is off or your profile is read only.
ERRORS.INVALID: Could not save: check the chosen value.
ERRORS.NO_PERMISSION: Your access profile does not allow this.

ORDER.NOTE_HINT: Each change is logged as a private note in this conversation.
ORDER.VIEW_ONLY: Your profile can only view service orders.

CONTACT.SUGGESTIONS: This contact is not linked to an ERP customer yet. It looks like:
CONTACT.NO_LINK: This contact is not linked to an ERP customer yet.
CONTACT.NO_RESULTS: No customer with orders in the configured period.
CONTACT.NO_ORDERS: No orders for this customer in the configured period.

QUOTES.EMPTY: No quotes for this customer in the configured period.

BOARD.MORE: and {count} more: use search or filters

SETTINGS.CONNECTION_HINT: Chatwoot reads the same web API the Mais Prático dashboard uses. Nothing from the ERP is stored here: it is a short-lived copy.
SETTINGS.BASE_URL_HINT: Only https on an inntegra.com.br address.
SETTINGS.COMPANIES_HINT: Comma separated, as in the ERP (e.g. somosemp, somosfilial). Only these are read and written.
SETTINGS.DEVICE_ID_HINT: The x-device-id header of a request from the ERP dashboard (DevTools > Network). Never shown again after saving.
SETTINGS.TEST_HINT: Fetches the orders from the ERP and shows how many came.
SETTINGS.MIRROR_HINT: Period read from the ERP and how long everyone shares the same copy.
SETTINGS.WRITE_HINT: Lets people change the sub-status and the fields below on an existing order. Creating or deleting orders only in the desktop system.
SETTINGS.NOTE_ON_CHANGE: Log each change as a private note in the conversation
SETTINGS.EXTRA_FIELDS_HINT: Only add a field after changing it in the ERP itself with DevTools open and reading the endpoint name.
SETTINGS.SUBSTATUS_HINT: One per line. Empty: taken from the sub-statuses already used in each company's orders.
SETTINGS.ERP_USER_HINT: idUsuario written to the sub-status history when the person has none (the ERP dashboard uses 0).
SETTINGS.INVALID: Check the fields marked in red.
